comparisons.physical_skill: Visually/physically select and transfer individual fragile items without moving a forbidden distractor.
comparisons.success_condition: Credit per released, supported cracker; any desiccant entry permanently zeros the run. Exact geometry is deferred to SCORING.md rather than included here.
comparisons.reason: Selective item picking is not the candidate's physical size/orientation separation of mixed free bodies through real apertures.

comparisons.objective: Reorient and clamp an angle-grinder guard toward the operator.
comparisons.physical_skill: Open a clamp lever, rotate a constrained guard around the spindle, and re-clamp while avoiding the disc.
comparisons.success_condition: Guard direction and lever angle within tolerances, grinder undisturbed, tools/hands clear; unsafe contact or forced rotation caps credit.
comparisons.reason: Articulated safety-guard adjustment tests clamp release and angular positioning, not granular screening.

comparisons.objective: Load two sample tubes into opposite centrifuge pockets for balance.
comparisons.physical_skill: Grasp and vertically insert two slender tubes into specified rotor pockets with spatial opposition reasoning.
comparisons.success_condition: Both tubes fully seated in diametrically opposite pockets for one second; unbalanced loading scores zero.
comparisons.reason: Paired insertion and rotor balancing are unrelated to screen-mediated separation.

comparisons.objective: Weigh exactly 1.00 g of granules on an analytical balance.
comparisons.physical_skill: Operate a draft-shield door and tare key, then incrementally pour a small granular dose with precision.
comparisons.success_condition: Correct tare with empty boat, final mass within stated tolerance, boat on pan and door preferably shut; spills reduce score.
comparisons.reason: It shares controlled pouring of granules, but tests quantitative dosing and balance operation, not orientation-dependent passage, bridge clearing, or retention of larger workpieces.

comparisons.objective: Move a scoopful of beads into a bowl.
comparisons.physical_skill: Collect and transport multiple loose beads together using a scoop.
comparisons.success_condition: Credit by settled bead count in the bowl, with five or more required for full score; no explicit spill/damage penalty beyond nondelivery.
comparisons.reason: This is bulk scooping and transfer. The candidate instead tests physical classification through apertures, transverse bridging, bounded agitation, and complete retention of washers.

comparisons.objective: Cut a cable tie off a cable bundle without damaging insulation.
comparisons.physical_skill: Stabilize a bundle, position flush cutters around a narrow strap, squeeze to sever it, and return the tool.
comparisons.success_condition: Tie severed and removed, insulation undamaged, bundle/tool restored and arms withdrawn; any nick scores zero.
comparisons.reason: Precision cutting near vulnerable cables has no meaningful overlap with granular separation.

comparisons.objective: Join a shelf to a cabinet side using two cam locks.
comparisons.physical_skill: Orient eccentric cams, align and insert a panel onto bolts/dowels, then turn both cams with screwdrivers.
comparisons.success_condition: Both bolt heads captured, cams locked, joint gap closed, tools returned and hands clear; closed-cam obstruction prevents success.
comparisons.reason: Bimanual panel assembly and rotary locking do not test screening, media flow, or selective retention.

comparisons.objective: Feed a laminating pouch sealed-edge-first and square into powered rollers.
comparisons.physical_skill: Detect subtle orientation, align a thin sheet to a slot, insert it to roller bite, and release at the correct time.
comparisons.success_condition: Square sealed-edge-first bite and complete passage; open-edge feed or holding after draw begins irreversibly jams and scores zero.
comparisons.reason: Thin-sheet slot feeding and release timing are materially different from moving a mixed granular load through an aperture array.

comparisons.objective: Recover finishing media from washers with a separating screen vs clear a printer jam and resume printing.
comparisons.physical_skill: Controlled granular sifting and washer retention vs synchronized bimanual straight pulling without tearing a card, followed by button pressing.
comparisons.success_condition: Candidate requires full feed, ≥98% media recovery, every washer retained, no loss/damage, and released 3 s support dwell; record requires intact card removal, table placement, OK press/print resumption, and 1 s clearance.
comparisons.reason: Both use two arms, but they test unrelated flow-separation and balanced-extraction abilities.

comparisons.objective: Screen finishing media from metal washers vs refit a long wardrobe rail into two unlike supports.
comparisons.physical_skill: Agitate orientation-dependent particles through apertures vs bimanually swing and tilt a long rigid rail into constrained end supports.
comparisons.success_condition: Mass recovery and retained washers with no spill plus released dwell vs both rail ends seated, rail level, still, and grippers clear.
comparisons.reason: Generic bimanual load sharing is shared, but aperture sifting and long-part insertion are meaningfully different.

comparisons.objective: Separate ceramic media from washers vs restock and lock a twin-roll tissue dispenser.
comparisons.physical_skill: Pour, grasp a screen, clear particle bridges, and reseat it vs manipulate rolls over sprung hubs, release controls, shutter, cover, and latch.
comparisons.success_condition: ≥98% recovered media with every washer retained and no loss vs correct stub/new-roll placement, hub engagement, cover latch, shutter state, and safe release.
comparisons.reason: The record tests multi-stage dispenser servicing, not size/orientation-based granular separation.

comparisons.objective: Screen media from washers vs remove capped Luer-lock needles and discard them safely.
comparisons.physical_skill: Bimanual screen motion governing granular flow vs stabilize syringes while twisting and extracting millimetre-scale threaded needles without uncapping.
comparisons.success_condition: Recovery fraction, retained washers, no spill/damage, released screen dwell vs each needle unscrewed and released inside sharps container, with any bare needle causing zero.
comparisons.reason: Both involve containment, but the tested contact mechanics—sifting versus threaded disassembly—are unrelated.

comparisons.objective: Separate finishing media from parts vs seat a shower cartridge and install its retaining clip.
comparisons.physical_skill: Controlled pouring and bridge-clearing agitation vs hold a spring-backed cartridge flush and square while inserting a U-clip.
comparisons.success_condition: ≥98% media in receiver, all washers in screen, no loss, screen released on supports vs cartridge and clip fully seated, retention proven under 20 N pull, hands clear.
comparisons.reason: This is granular separation rather than force-opposed alignment and clip insertion.

comparisons.objective: Screen ceramic media from washers vs crimp a board lid onto a foil pan.
comparisons.physical_skill: Orientation-dependent rigid-particle passage through holes vs progressive deformation of a soft rim while stabilizing the lid and pan.
comparisons.success_condition: Recovered mass and retained parts without spill vs specified fractions of rim folded flat, lid seated, pan undamaged, and hands clear.
comparisons.reason: The record tests controlled deformation; the candidate tests rigid granular flow and selective retention.

comparisons.objective: Separate already formed ceramic media from metal parts vs grind peppercorns to a specified particle-size distribution.
comparisons.physical_skill: Mobilize intact elongated bodies through a screen while retaining larger workpieces vs apply pestle pressure/impact to fracture material in a mortar.
comparisons.success_condition: ≥98% intact media recovered with no spill and all washers retained vs required mass fractions passing 1.4 mm and 0.6 mm test sieves, limited loss, and safe pestle set-down.
comparisons.reason: Although both mention sieves and mass fractions, the record uses sieves only to measure comminution; it does not test operating a separating screen.

comparisons.objective: Separate media from washers vs replace a clipper guide comb.
comparisons.physical_skill: Granular-flow control with a bimanually held screen vs remove, align, slide, and snap a selected guide onto a loose clipper.
comparisons.success_condition: Mass recovery, retention, no contamination/loss, and stable released screen vs old guide removed, number 4 aligned and latched, other guides undisturbed, released 1 s.
comparisons.reason: Snap-fit accessory replacement does not test selective aperture passage or granular handling.

comparisons.objective: Recover finishing media with a screen vs measure brake-rotor thickness with a micrometer.
comparisons.physical_skill: Pouring and bounded agitation of a loaded screen vs square tool placement, precision thimble/ratchet adjustment, and reading preservation.
comparisons.success_condition: ≥98% media recovery and all washers retained vs ±0.02 mm thickness reading, ratchet clicks, tool removal, and return to its rest.
comparisons.reason: The record is precision metrology, not material separation.

comparisons.objective: Screen media from finished parts vs close a telescoping-lid product box.
comparisons.physical_skill: Bimanual load sharing and particle bridge release vs level, square, close-clearance lid alignment without wedging.
comparisons.success_condition: Recovery/retention with no spill and released support dwell vs lid fully seated, centred, square, product enclosed, box still and released.
comparisons.reason: Both require careful placement, but only the candidate tests granular flow through real apertures.

comparisons.objective: Separate finishing media from washers vs clear a fragile egg before placing a pot on a trivet.
comparisons.physical_skill: Controlled screen pouring and agitation vs inspect a placement surface, relocate a fragile obstruction, and set down a heavy object safely.
comparisons.success_condition: ≥98% media recovered, washers retained, no loss/damage, screen released vs egg safely supported, pot fully on trivet, no harmful contact, both released and still.
comparisons.reason: Safe obstruction clearing and placement do not exercise selective granular separation.

comparisons.objective: Separate a mixed batch using a manual screen vs pick four parts from two moving lanes before deadlines.
comparisons.physical_skill: Orientation-sensitive particle passage and bridge clearing vs time-prioritized interception and direct pick-and-place from conveyors.
comparisons.success_condition: Full feed, ≥98% media recovery, washers retained, no spill vs each cube placed directly in the bin before leaving reach, with no temporary staging.
comparisons.reason: The record tests scheduling and dynamic picking; the candidate tests bulk separation physics.

comparisons.objective: Screen finishing media from washers vs measure a training doll's recumbent length.
comparisons.physical_skill: Bimanual screen handling and granular-flow control vs straighten and hold two sprung legs while closing a measuring footboard.
comparisons.success_condition: Recovery/retention and released screen dwell vs specified hip/knee extension, crown and sole contact, stable reading, safe doll support, and release.
comparisons.reason: The shared need for coordinated force does not make sprung articulated-body measurement overlap with sifting.

comparisons.objective: Separate media from parts vs safely set a spring rat trap.
comparisons.physical_skill: Bounded tilt/agitation of a loaded screen vs restrain a spring hammer while positioning a lock bar and avoiding its strike path.
comparisons.success_condition: ≥98% recovery with no spill or washer loss vs trap latched, no snap or unsafe gripper exposure, and arms withdrawn.
comparisons.reason: Spring restraint and safety-latch manipulation are not granular separation.

comparisons.objective: Recover media through a screen vs attach a booster-seat tray at the second notch.
comparisons.physical_skill: Granular bridge clearing and screen reseating vs bimanually align a wide tray and engage two separated catches at one indexed setting.
comparisons.success_condition: Recovered media mass and retained washers with clean release vs both catches locked in notch two, tray supported and centred, booster unmoved, hands clear.
comparisons.reason: The record tests wide-part alignment and simultaneous latching, not particle classification.

comparisons.objective: Separate finishing media from metal parts vs tear open a shelf-ready can tray along a perforation.
comparisons.physical_skill: Controlled pouring and aperture-based sifting vs stabilize packaging while propagating a tear along a designed seam.
comparisons.success_condition: ≥98% recovery, all washers retained, no spill/damage vs front panel removed along the perforation with cans/package kept safe and the result released.
comparisons.reason: Perforation tearing and granular screening test different physical abilities.

comparisons.objective: Screen media from washers vs extend and relock a telescoping paint-roller pole.
comparisons.physical_skill: Bimanual screen load sharing and agitation vs counter-twist tubes to release a twist lock, slide to a mark, then torque-lock.
comparisons.success_condition: Mass-based separation with no loss and stable released screen vs target pole length, lock engagement, torque/holding integrity, and release.
comparisons.reason: Twist-lock manipulation and calibrated extension do not overlap with granular separation.

comparisons.objective: Separate bulk media from washers vs transfer four sealed cups of unknown weight without crushing or dropping them.
comparisons.physical_skill: Control tool pose to pass elongated particles through apertures vs adapt side-wall grip force to hidden loads while transporting fragile containers.
comparisons.success_condition: ≥98% media recovery and all washers retained vs every cup side-gripped, lifted, delivered upright, unbuckled, undropped, and released on the tray.
comparisons.reason: Both penalize loss, but adaptive fragile-object gripping is not screen-mediated separation.

comparisons.objective: Screen media from finished parts vs remove a tote whose strap is caught on a rake.
comparisons.physical_skill: Granular-flow control through apertures vs disentangle a flexible ring/strap from a tine before transporting the tote without dragging the rake.
comparisons.success_condition: Recovery fraction, washer retention, no spill, screen reseated vs ring freed, rake remains safely on shelf, tote placed and released on table.
comparisons.reason: Entanglement resolution and tote transport are materially different from granular sifting.

comparisons.objective: Separate media with a manual screen vs turn a multimeter selector to OFF.
comparisons.physical_skill: Bimanual pouring, agitation, and support placement vs precise single rotary-control manipulation among adjacent features.
comparisons.success_condition: ≥98% recovery, retained washers, no loss, released 3 s dwell vs dial at 115°±3°, valid on spindle, low motion for 2 s.
comparisons.reason: A shallow selector rotation does not test bulk-material separation.

comparisons.objective: Screen finishing media from washers vs install a case fan into a tool-less bracket.
comparisons.physical_skill: Orientation-dependent particle passage and bridge release vs lift, align, press-fit, and snap two latches over a rigid fan.
comparisons.success_condition: Mass recovery and part retention without spill vs fan seated square on ring, both latches engaged, grippers clear, and fan stable.
comparisons.reason: Snap-in rigid assembly is separate from selective granular flow.

comparisons.objective: Separate media from washers vs re-space shelf wire dividers to a planogram.
comparisons.physical_skill: Bimanual screen manipulation and controlled agitation vs lift, relocate, and simultaneously seat divider feet and fence hooks in indexed holes.
comparisons.success_condition: ≥98% media recovered with every washer retained vs dividers in prescribed holes with hooks engaged, boxes undisturbed, and grippers clear.
comparisons.reason: The record tests repeated indexed insertion and merchandising layout, not sifting.

comparisons.objective: Separate intact ceramic media from metal washers vs grate a target mass of cheese into a dish.
comparisons.physical_skill: Mobilize existing rigid particles through screen apertures while retaining parts vs stabilize a grater and repeatedly shear material with controlled pressure and safe finger clearance.
comparisons.success_condition: ≥98% recovered media, all washers retained, no spill/damage, released screen vs 15–25 g grated into dish, grater retained, cheese returned, blade clearance, and 1 s stillness.
comparisons.reason: Both handle many small pieces, but grating creates material by cutting; the candidate classifies intact bodies by aperture passage.

comparisons.objective: Screen finishing media from washers vs lift a power cord so a cart can pass underneath.
comparisons.physical_skill: Controlled pouring and granular agitation vs coordinate deformable-cable lifting with cart translation and restore the cable afterward.
comparisons.success_condition: Recovery/retention without loss plus released support dwell vs cart crosses with verified clearance, remains on table, and cable is returned and released.
comparisons.reason: Deformable obstacle management and cart passage do not test granular screening.

comparisons.objective: Separate finishing media from washers vs clear clutter from a laptop and open its lid safely.
comparisons.physical_skill: Bimanual screen grasping, pouring, and bridge clearing vs sequentially relocate fragile/spillable objects and open a stiff hinged lid without moving the base.
comparisons.success_condition: ≥98% media recovery, washers retained, no spill/damage, screen released vs clutter safely set down, no spill/fall/base movement, lid opened, and objects stable.
comparisons.reason: The record tests hazard-aware clutter clearing and hinged opening, not aperture-based separation.

comparisons.objective: Load, centre, and focus a microscope slide without contacting the objective.
comparisons.physical_skill: Slide loading under a spring jaw and precision knob rotation for planar centring and working-distance control.
comparisons.success_condition: Slide seated and centred; specimen within 1.5 mm of the optical axis; focus within 0.5 mm; objective clearance never below 0.5 mm. Earlier versions only graded focus. No material-recovery rubric is missing.
comparisons.reason: The candidate tests pouring and orientation-dependent screening of granular media while retaining larger parts; microscope loading and geared stage adjustment test a different physical ability.

comparisons.objective: Insert a circuit board into a held antistatic bag and place the loaded bag in a crate.
comparisons.physical_skill: Bimanual deformable-container opening, flat insertion, placement, and release.
comparisons.success_condition: Board fully inside the bag near its closed end; bag resting flat inside the crate, released and still. Damage criteria for the board and bag are not specified.
comparisons.reason: Both use two hands and insertion, but this record tests flat-part insertion into a deformable sleeve, not aperture-based granular separation, bridge clearing, or selective retention.

comparisons.objective: Select a suitable reach rod and press a guarded reset button through a service port.
comparisons.physical_skill: Tool selection, grasping a reach extension, constrained port insertion, alignment, and sustained pressing.
comparisons.success_condition: Button depressed at least 5 mm for one second while a bar extends at least 50 mm through the port and remains near horizontal. No explicit damage rubric is given.
comparisons.reason: Constrained rod insertion and remote button actuation are materially different from pouring a mixture through a screen and controlling granular flow.

comparisons.objective: Post a packet completely through a sprung drop-box flap.
comparisons.physical_skill: Grasp-position planning, flap actuation through contact, packet insertion, release, and gravity-assisted drop.
comparisons.success_condition: Packet wholly inside and at rest, with the flap closed within 5 mm for one second; no partial credit or explicit packet-damage threshold.
comparisons.reason: This tests single-object insertion past an obstructing flap. It does not test selective size separation, multiple free bodies, bridging, or retention of workpieces.

comparisons.objective: Wrap pipe threads with thread-seal tape in the fitting direction and return the dispenser.
comparisons.physical_skill: Continuous deformable tape handling, tensioned winding, tearing, and tail pressing.
comparisons.success_condition: Clockwise wrap of 3–6 turns with specified coverage and end clearance, tape torn and tail pressed, dispenser returned and released. Tape damage beyond incorrect coverage is not separately defined.
comparisons.reason: Tape winding and controlled tearing are unrelated to rigid granular screening despite both involving coordinated tool handling.

comparisons.objective: Verify that a seat-belt retractor locks after a steady pull followed by a jerk, then let it rewind.
comparisons.physical_skill: Velocity-profile control, transient jerk generation, force resistance testing, and release.
comparisons.success_condition: Steady 150 mm extension precedes a qualifying jerk; run-on stays within 15 mm; later versions require continued hand travel against the lock, rewind, and clear release. Webbing damage is not graded.
comparisons.reason: The tested ability is dynamic latch testing through a controlled acceleration change, not granular transport or size-selective screening.

comparisons.objective: Open a drink can using its stay-on tab.
comparisons.physical_skill: Fine pinch in a recessed area, tab lifting about a rivet, and seal-breaking force control.
comparisons.success_condition: Panel depressed at least 45 degrees after the tab was raised at least 10 degrees; later versions require hands clear for one second. Spill and can damage are not specified.
comparisons.reason: Fine tab manipulation and seal rupture do not exercise the candidate’s bimanual screen handling, granular-flow control, or part retention.

comparisons.objective: Cut a board or plank on a running table saw using push sticks while maintaining blade clearance.
comparisons.physical_skill: Guided stock feeding, push-stick use, alignment against a fence, and safety-distance control.
comparisons.success_condition: Complete accurate cut with pieces flat and released; zero for blade-zone entry, tool/blade contact, lifting over the blade, kick-up, or loss. Versions differ between rip and cross-cut geometry.
comparisons.reason: Saw feeding and cutting are force-guided machining operations with blade hazards, not granular separation. Shared bimanual coordination is only generic.

comparisons.objective: Steady a plumb bob and mark the worktop directly beneath a shelf hole.
comparisons.physical_skill: Oscillation damping without continued contact, visual/spatial projection, and precise pencil marking.
comparisons.success_condition: Bob freely still within 3 mm for 1.5 seconds; every mark made during that state and within 3 mm of plumb; pencil lifted. Surface-damage limits beyond mark placement are absent.
comparisons.reason: Pendulum stabilization and point marking test precision metrology, not pouring, screening, bridge release, or selective retention.

comparisons.objective: Zip an already-started jacket while pinning the garment.
comparisons.physical_skill: Bimanual stabilization of a deformable garment, small pull-tab grasping, force-guided sliding, and regrasping.
comparisons.success_condition: Slider within 3 mm of the top, both grippers over 40 mm clear, and the zipper pin never protruding over 3 mm. Fabric or zipper damage is otherwise unspecified.
comparisons.reason: Deformable garment stabilization and zipper travel are materially different from rigid-body granular separation.

comparisons.objective: Refit a washed baffle filter into a range hood and secure it with its spring latch.
comparisons.physical_skill: Large-panel alignment, trough insertion, flattening, latch engagement, and collision-free release.
comparisons.success_condition: Bottom edge in trough, filter aligned within 3 mm and 3 degrees, latch returned within 1.5 mm, released for one second; dropping after lift zeros the run. Other damage thresholds are absent.
comparisons.reason: Although both involve seating and releasing a large object, this tests panel insertion and latching rather than manipulating a perforated tool to separate granular media.

comparisons.objective: Use a scoop to deliver clean ice to a bowl without cross-contamination.
comparisons.physical_skill: Lid opening, scooping discrete cubes, containment during transport, pouring/release, and hygiene-aware source selection.
comparisons.success_condition: At least one clean-source cube delivered by the scoop, settled and released, with lid history and no contamination; fish-source, hand-carried, or dirty-scoop delivery loses full credit. Cube loss outside the bowl is not fully quantified.
comparisons.reason: This tests hygienic source selection and scoop delivery. It lacks aperture-based separation, orientation-dependent passage, bridging, and mandatory retention of larger workpieces.

comparisons.objective: Use a scoop to deliver clean ice to a bowl without cross-contamination.
comparisons.physical_skill: Lid opening, scooping discrete cubes, containment during transport, pouring/release, and hygiene-aware source selection.
comparisons.success_condition: At least one clean-source cube delivered by the scoop, settled and released, with lid history and no contamination; fish-source, hand-carried, or dirty-scoop delivery loses full credit. Cube loss outside the bowl is not fully quantified.
comparisons.reason: Despite shared discrete-object flow, the record grades clean-source delivery rather than physical size separation through apertures and retention of nonpassing parts.

comparisons.objective: Move a lamp safely closer, then place its plug in a tray.
comparisons.physical_skill: Whole-object relocation with an attached flexible cord, tension management, plug manipulation, and release.
comparisons.success_condition: Plug lies in the tray and lamp remains upright and released; tipping, dragging over 3 cm, cord pullout, tray movement, or loss zeros the run. Cord damage short of pullout is unspecified.
comparisons.reason: Cord-tether management and plug delivery test a different physical ability from granular screening.

comparisons.objective: Hold a cord taut and cut it with a knife away from the holding hand.
comparisons.physical_skill: Bimanual tensioning, edged-tool control, guarded cutting, and safe placement.
comparisons.success_condition: Cord severed at safe distances while held; blade never contacts robot or table; knife released on the table and nothing lost. Cord tension has no numeric threshold.
comparisons.reason: Tensioned cutting and blade safety do not overlap meaningfully with aperture-based media recovery.

comparisons.objective: Pour a heavy pot of soup into a tureen without spilling, then return the pot to the hob.
comparisons.physical_skill: Bimanual heavy-vessel load sharing, controlled tilting, liquid-like pouring, righting, and placement.
comparisons.success_condition: At least 1,530 ml of 1,800 ml transferred, no more than 75 ml spilled, and pot upright on the hob; unsafe low-height tilt zeros the run. Damage to vessels is not specified.
comparisons.reason: This is the closest generic pouring record, but it tests heavy vessel handling and bulk transfer. The candidate additionally tests selective aperture passage, orientation-dependent bridging, agitation, and retention of every washer, which are meaningfully different abilities.

comparisons.objective: Unfold, orient, and hang folding headphones on a stand.
comparisons.physical_skill: Multi-joint articulated-object manipulation, earcup orientation, placement, and stable release.
comparisons.success_condition: Both fold joints unfolded, both cushions facing inward within 15 degrees, and headband released stably in the cradle for five seconds. Damage thresholds are absent.
comparisons.reason: Articulated reconfiguration and hanging do not test granular flow or selective separation.

comparisons.objective: Tip a counting tray to pour exactly the counted tablets into a vial held off the table while leaving extras behind.
comparisons.physical_skill: Bimanual vessel alignment, small-object pouring, count preservation, and spill avoidance.
comparisons.success_condition: All ten counted tablets enter the raised vial, all six extras remain on the counting area, and none spill; later versions latch any spill or extra-tablet transfer as zero. Tablet damage is not graded.
comparisons.reason: Both involve bimanual pouring of discrete bodies and retaining some objects. However, this record relies on prior spatial partition and count-preserving transfer, whereas the candidate tests physical separation by aperture size/orientation, transverse bridging, controlled agitation, and screen reseating.

comparisons.objective: Open a stiff sliding window using its delicate handle without tearing it off.
comparisons.physical_skill: Force-limited handle grasping, sustained traction, friction overcoming, and possible regrasping.
comparisons.success_condition: Up to full credit at 150 mm handle-driven sash travel; any handle detachment or glass/frame damage zeros the score. Later versions restrict credit to travel caused by a valid handle grasp.
comparisons.reason: Force-limited prismatic actuation through a fragile handle is unrelated to granular screening.

comparisons.objective: Assemble three gears on shafts while finding compatible tooth phases by contact.

comparisons.reason: Gear phase alignment and shaft insertion are different from orientation-dependent passage of loose media through a screen.

comparisons.objective: Lock out an air conditioner using a pull-out disconnect and padlock without disturbing a second disconnect.
comparisons.physical_skill: Cover manipulation, keyed block extraction, 180-degree reorientation, reinsertion, latch closure, and padlock placement.

comparisons.objective: Use a physical mouse to drag a file into the correct on-screen folder and release the mouse.

comparisons.objective: Lower a water-loaded hotel pan level into a steam-table well and release it.

comparisons.success_condition: No overflow or excessive speed; pan centred within 8 mm, flange corners within 2 mm, tilt at most 2 degrees, released and still for one second. Later scoring computes overflow from freeboard; structural damage is unspecified.

comparisons.objective: Free a disc from a game case, orient it upright, and insert it into a slot-loading console.

comparisons.objective: Attach a price ticket through a garment care label without piercing the shirt.

comparisons.success_condition: Fastener fired through label alone with 20 mm shirt clearance; label lowered, released, and held 1 s; piercing or tearing fails.
comparisons.reason: The candidate tests size-selective granular separation through apertures, not guarded needle insertion through a held flap. No material rubric detail is missing.

comparisons.objective: Hand-guide a Franka arm to a service pose and teach it.
comparisons.physical_skill: Maintain a three-position enabling switch in its middle band while dragging an articulated arm and pressing Teach.
comparisons.success_condition: Reach within 15 mm and 5 degrees, release controls, teach pose, clear hands, and hold 1 s; collisions and joint-limit contact fail.
comparisons.reason: Constrained robot hand-guiding and safety-button control do not test pouring, bridging, or screen-mediated material separation. No material rubric detail is missing.

comparisons.objective: Secure a clevis pin by bending both cotter-pin legs in opposite directions.
comparisons.physical_skill: Controlled plastic bending of two slender legs without harmful rebending.
comparisons.success_condition: Both legs bent at least 60 degrees, hands clear, still for 1 s; specified rebending permanently fails.
comparisons.reason: Permanent fastener deformation is unrelated to retaining large parts while passing smaller media through a screen. No material rubric detail is missing.

comparisons.objective: Unlock a liquid-soap pump and leave it ready to press.
comparisons.physical_skill: Counterhold and twist coupled pump components to produce relative head rise.
comparisons.success_condition: Head rises at least 15 mm relative to an upright bottle; robot clears 80 mm and state remains stable for 21 samples.
comparisons.reason: Thread/latch release with relative component motion does not test granular flow or aperture selection. No material rubric detail is missing.

comparisons.objective: Press three culture-tube caps to their vented first stops.
comparisons.physical_skill: Repeated axial alignment and bounded-depth snap insertion.
comparisons.success_condition: All caps centered, upright, and depressed 4–6 mm, then still for 1 s; over-seating does not count.
comparisons.reason: Precision snap seating differs from manipulating a screen to clear orientation-dependent particle bridges. No material rubric detail is missing.

comparisons.objective: Present a calibration board to a camera in the views needed for calibration, then return it.
comparisons.physical_skill: Pose a rigid board through multiple unobstructed camera views and replace it in a rack.
comparisons.success_condition: Meet nine image-view targets, recover focal length within 2%, rerack, clear hands, and hold 1 s.
comparisons.reason: Multi-view visual calibration does not test physical size separation, particle passage, or spill avoidance. No material rubric detail is missing.

comparisons.objective: Fit and lock a T8 tube in two rotor lampholders.
comparisons.physical_skill: Bimanually carry a long tube level, align both pin pairs, insert them simultaneously, and quarter-turn both rotors.
comparisons.success_condition: Both ends inserted, rotors at 90 degrees, lamp lit, hands 30 mm clear, stable for 1 s; dropping fails.
comparisons.reason: Long-part dual-ended insertion and rotary locking are meaningfully different from granular screening. No material rubric detail is missing.

comparisons.objective: Clip a wafer to an evaporator plate and load it face-down into a load lock.
comparisons.physical_skill: Center a fragile wafer, swing and tighten multiple clips, invert/load an assembly, and operate a timed door lock.
comparisons.success_condition: Wafer securely clipped, plate correctly loaded face-down, door shut and locked, hands clear; contact, over-tightening, or timing violations fail.
comparisons.reason: Fragile fixture loading and clip tightening do not test screen-driven particle separation. No material rubric detail is missing.

comparisons.objective: Route and stow a cable clear of a hot plate.
comparisons.physical_skill: Manipulate a deformable cable around a keep-out region and seat its plug in a holder.
comparisons.success_condition: Plug seated and released; entire cable rests at least 50 mm from the hot plate for 1 s; passing over it permanently fails.
comparisons.reason: Deformable cable routing around a hazard is unrelated to rigid granular flow through apertures. No material rubric detail is missing.

comparisons.objective: Open a flashlight and tip its battery into a picking bin.
comparisons.physical_skill: Bimanual threaded disassembly followed by controlled tipping and placement of three rigid parts.
comparisons.success_condition: Cap unscrewed and placed, battery contained in box, flashlight placed outside it, all still for 1 s; forced removal or loss fails.
comparisons.reason: It shares controlled pouring of one object into a receptacle, but has no selective screen, bridging, retained population, or recovery-fraction control. No material rubric detail is missing.

comparisons.objective: Sort colored cubes while responding to a high-level alarm by closing an inlet.
comparisons.physical_skill: Discrete pick-and-place classification interleaved with time-critical valve operation.
comparisons.success_condition: Cubes in color-matched bins and inlet closed after alarm but before overflow; overflow fails.
comparisons.reason: Appearance-based discrete sorting plus alarm response does not test geometry-based separation of a mixture through physical apertures. No material rubric detail is missing.

comparisons.objective: Remove a glass pane with two suction lifters and lay it on bearers.
comparisons.physical_skill: Attach two lifters, share a fragile planar load, transport it level, place it, and release the lifters.
comparisons.success_condition: Pane lifted with both lifters, placed flat and centered, lifters unlocked, hands clear, stable 1 s; drops, excess tilt, or direct contact fail.
comparisons.reason: Although both require bimanual load sharing, glass transport lacks pouring, granular agitation, bridge clearing, and selective retention. No material rubric detail is missing.

comparisons.objective: Install a blanking panel at rack unit U6.
comparisons.physical_skill: Align and push both ends of a panel into a specified rack position.
comparisons.success_condition: Panel aligned within 3 mm at U6, both ends home, released for 1 s.
comparisons.reason: Rack-panel placement is a rigid insertion task, not material separation. No material rubric detail is missing.

comparisons.objective: Secure a gas cylinder to a wall bracket with a chain.
comparisons.physical_skill: Route, hook, and tension a chain around an upright cylinder without contacting its valve.
comparisons.success_condition: Chain correctly positioned, hooked and snug; hands clear; cylinder passes a 10 N pull test without excessive tilt.
comparisons.reason: Chain routing and restraint verification do not test particle flow or screening. No material rubric detail is missing.

comparisons.objective: Connect a tractor air-line gladhand to the correct trailer coupling.
comparisons.physical_skill: Remove, align, press, and rotate a hose-mounted connector into a bayonet-like lock.
comparisons.success_condition: Correct coupling fully locked and pull-resistant, hose retained, hands clear for 1 s; wrong coupling or dropped hose fails.
comparisons.reason: Compliant-hose connector locking is unrelated to geometry-selective granular separation. No material rubric detail is missing.

comparisons.objective: Wire a door-mounted lamp across a junction-box hinge and latch the door.
comparisons.physical_skill: Insert a plug, route and clip a cord, close a hinged door, and preserve routing through a door-cycle test.
comparisons.success_condition: Plug remains seated, cord remains clipped and untrapped, door relatches after cycling, hands clear, stable 1 s.
comparisons.reason: Cable insertion and hinge-clearance routing do not test sieving, bridge release, or mixture retention. No material rubric detail is missing.

comparisons.objective: Open a casement window to the last peg-stay hole.
comparisons.physical_skill: Lift a perforated stay off a pin, move the sash, and reseat the correct hole without entering the glass space.
comparisons.success_condition: Fourth hole fully seated on pin, hands clear, window still for 1 s; glass-space intrusion fails.
comparisons.reason: Hinged-window positioning and peg engagement differ from granular-flow control. No material rubric detail is missing.

comparisons.objective: Empty used capsules and restore a capsule machine with a fresh capsule.
comparisons.physical_skill: Bulk transfer loose capsules, fit a collector, seat a fresh capsule, and close the machine.
comparisons.success_condition: Seven used capsules in recycling tray, collector fitted, fresh capsule seated, head closed, hands released, stable 1 s.
comparisons.reason: This includes loose-object transfer but no aperture-based selective separation, retained workpieces, or bridge clearing. The record gives thresholds but only a terse drop/invalid failure definition.

comparisons.objective: Extract one toilet roll from a packed case by its core and place it upright in a bin.
comparisons.physical_skill: Internal-core grasping and single-item extraction without disturbing neighboring compressible rolls.
comparisons.success_condition: Exactly one roll released upright in bin, remaining rolls acceptably placed, all still for 2 s; removal/loss violations fail under the applicable spec.
comparisons.reason: Selective extraction from a packed array does not test granular screening; spec versions differ on whether transient neighbor motion itself is penalized, but both remain clearly distinct.

comparisons.objective: Pack bottle, shoes, wallet, and headphones into a gym bag, with later specs separating dirty shoes from clean accessories.
comparisons.physical_skill: Multi-object packing and spatial grouping inside a deformable-looking container.
comparisons.success_condition: Objects fully contained, released, still for 40 controls; later version also requires 120 mm separation between groups.
comparisons.reason: Multi-object packing is opposite in outcome to separating a mixture through a tool. Spec versions differ on grouping and point allocation, but neither overlaps the candidate ability.

comparisons.objective: Open a folded wheelchair fully and leave it standing in place.
comparisons.physical_skill: Bimanually spread a coupled folding mechanism and seat both rails in saddles without tipping or translating it.
comparisons.success_condition: Both rails seated, all wheels down, chair near its start pose, hands 50 mm clear, stable 1 s; tip or large displacement permanently fails.
comparisons.reason: Deploying a folding mechanism does not test selective granular flow. No material rubric detail is missing.

comparisons.objective: Tear the front panel from a shelf-ready tray while leaving every can upright.
comparisons.physical_skill: Controlled tearing along a perforation while stabilizing a loaded carton.
comparisons.success_condition: All ties torn on-line, panel removed, tray nearly unmoved, 12 cans upright, hands clear, stable 1 s; off-line tearing or excess tray tilt fails.
comparisons.reason: Perforation tearing with load preservation is different from aperture screening and media recovery. No material rubric detail is missing.

comparisons.objective: Store a knife in an obstructed holder after safely removing a toy.
comparisons.physical_skill: Clear an obstruction, then perform narrow-slot blade insertion with controlled pose and speed.
comparisons.success_condition: Knife inserted 140–157 mm with bounded alignment and speed, toy safely released outside holder, both TCPs clear, held 1 s.
comparisons.reason: Obstacle removal and precision slot insertion do not test particle-size separation. No material rubric detail is missing.

comparisons.objective: Join two pipes by sliding a repair coupling across their joint.
comparisons.physical_skill: Lift and align a loose pipe end while translating a sleeve coupling over both pipes.
comparisons.success_condition: Each pipe at least 30 mm inside centered coupling, pipe aligned and home, grippers 50 mm clear, still 1 s; separation or dropped parts fails.
comparisons.reason: Coaxial alignment and sleeve insertion are unrelated to granular screening. No material rubric detail is missing.

comparisons.objective: Arrange two beveled steel coupons for a V-groove weld.
comparisons.physical_skill: Reorient and precisely place two plates with controlled gap, parallelism, and end alignment.
comparisons.success_condition: Both flat, bevels facing, 1.6–3.2 mm root gap at both ends, ends aligned within 5 mm, stable 1 s.
comparisons.reason: Precision planar fixture preparation does not test granular flow or selective retention. No material rubric detail is missing.

comparisons.objective: Fold a lever nail clipper shut for storage.
comparisons.physical_skill: Reorient a captive lever through its folding mechanism and reseat the clipper in a tray slot.
comparisons.success_condition: Lever points toward tail, heel up and flat within 2 mm, clipper seated, hands 30 mm clear, stable 1 s.
comparisons.reason: Single-mechanism folding is unrelated to mixture separation. No material rubric detail is missing.

comparisons.objective: Set and clamp a pneumatic-cylinder slot sensor at the middle of its switching range.
comparisons.physical_skill: Use a seated hex driver to drag a sensor along a slot, locate a functional band, and tighten its clamp.
comparisons.success_condition: Sensor within 1 mm of band center, passes rod-cycle and 10 N push tests, hands clear, held 2 s; stripping fails.
comparisons.reason: Tool-mediated sensor adjustment and clamping do not test screening or particle recovery. No material rubric detail is missing.

comparisons.objective: Hot-swap a failed server power supply without moving the live supply.
comparisons.physical_skill: Operate a release latch, extract one heavy module, align and insert a replacement in a crowded bay.
comparisons.success_condition: Spare seated and latched in failed bay, failed unit clear, live unit never moved over 5 mm, replacement stable 1 s.
comparisons.reason: Module extraction and blind rail insertion are unrelated to granular separation. Spec versions clarify latch nomenclature and dwell timing without changing the tested ability.

comparisons.objective: Reassemble a table fan after washing.
comparisons.physical_skill: Key a blade onto a shaft, counterhold it while threading a spinner, align a grille, and close four clips.
comparisons.success_condition: Blade keyed, spinner tight, grille seated with all clips closed, hands clear, stable 1 s.
comparisons.reason: Sequential keyed assembly, threading, and latching do not test media passage through a screen. No material rubric detail is missing.

comparisons.objective: Thread a lamp cord through its pipe with a specified protruding length.
comparisons.physical_skill: Feed a flexible cord through a long constrained passage and meter the exposed end.
comparisons.success_condition: Cord exits top by 60–100 mm, released and still for 1 s.
comparisons.reason: Deformable linear threading differs from orientation-dependent rigid-particle screening. No material rubric detail is missing.

comparisons.objective: Lift a cake from a deep tin using both ends of a parchment sling and place it on a rack.
comparisons.physical_skill: Bimanually tension a flexible sling, share a fragile load, lift vertically, and place level.
comparisons.success_condition: Cake wholly removed and resting near rack center, under 5 degrees tilt, hands clear; direct contact, drop, or tilt over 35 degrees fails.
comparisons.reason: It shares bimanual load sharing and spill-like tilt avoidance, but lacks mixture pouring, selective apertures, granular bridging, and retained workpieces. No material rubric detail is missing.

comparisons.objective: Bend a copper tube to 90 degrees while compensating for springback.
comparisons.physical_skill: Operate a lever bender past the target and relax it to achieve a precise permanent bend.
comparisons.success_condition: Relaxed tube measures 87–93 degrees, lever returned, grippers clear, stable 1 s; over-bending beyond 96 degrees fails.
comparisons.reason: Controlled plastic deformation and springback compensation are unrelated to granular separation. No material rubric detail is missing.

comparisons.objective: Screen ceramic finishing media from retained washers, versus opening a crown-capped bottle with a mounted opener.
comparisons.physical_skill: Bimanual pouring, screen support, agitation and granular separation versus positioning a bottle under a fixed tooth and levering off its cap.
comparisons.success_condition: Media recovery, washer retention, zero spill and released screen dwell versus cap removal and upright bottle placement on a coaster.
comparisons.reason: The record tests fixed-tool cap levering, not selective particle passage through a manipulated screen.

comparisons.objective: Separate finishing media from washers, versus spacing parcels on a moving conveyor before scanning.
comparisons.physical_skill: Orientation-dependent sifting and bimanual load sharing versus time-critical parcel repositioning on a moving belt.
comparisons.success_condition: At least 98% media recovery with all washers retained and no loss versus two specified inter-parcel gaps while parcels remain on the belt.
comparisons.reason: Conveyor singulation does not test aperture-based separation or granular bridge clearing.

comparisons.objective: Screen media from finished washers, versus diverting reject cartons from a moving line while preserving good cartons.
comparisons.physical_skill: Controlled pouring and bimanual screen agitation versus lateral pushing of selected cartons during conveyor motion.
comparisons.success_condition: Recovered media mass, washer preservation and safe screen release versus rejects on the reject table and good cartons undisturbed.
comparisons.reason: Both involve selective handling, but the tested mechanics—granular screening versus conveyor diversion—are meaningfully different.

comparisons.objective: Separate loose ceramic media from washers, versus fastening a splash-shield panel with a push-in clip.
comparisons.physical_skill: Bimanual sifting and bridge release versus aligning two holes and forcefully inserting a retaining clip.
comparisons.success_condition: Mass-based recovery with no spill or washer loss versus aligned panel and fully seated, captured clip.
comparisons.reason: The record tests precision alignment and insertion rather than bulk separation through apertures.

comparisons.objective: Recover finishing media while retaining washers, versus unpicking a sewn seam without harming fabric.
comparisons.physical_skill: Rigid-body pouring and screen agitation versus fine tool-guided thread cutting and extraction around deformable fabric.
comparisons.success_condition: Recovered media fraction and retained undamaged washers versus removed stitches with fabric preserved.
comparisons.reason: The manipulation regimes and observable outcomes are unrelated.

comparisons.objective: Screen a dry media/workpiece mixture, versus pegging a T-shirt onto a clothesline.
comparisons.physical_skill: Bimanual load sharing and granular-flow control versus opening spring pegs and clamping deformable cloth to a line.
comparisons.success_condition: Media in receiver, washers in screen and no loss versus shirt securely suspended by pegs.
comparisons.reason: Shared bimanual handling is generic; the record does not test separation or orientation-dependent particle flow.

comparisons.objective: Separate finishing media from washers, versus adjusting a drum-brake star wheel.
comparisons.physical_skill: Pouring and bounded screen agitation versus confined-access incremental rotation of an adjuster mechanism.
comparisons.success_condition: Recovery, retention and spill-free released dwell versus brake adjustment reaching the specified mechanical state.
comparisons.reason: The record tests confined mechanism adjustment, not granular screening.

comparisons.objective: Screen ceramic media from metal washers, versus untying a loose overhand knot.
comparisons.physical_skill: Rigid granular flow and bimanual screen control versus deformable-cord loop identification, loosening and end extraction.
comparisons.success_condition: At least 98% recovery with washers retained versus knot eliminated and cord left in the required released state.
comparisons.reason: The tested physical abilities are substantially different despite both permitting bimanual work.

comparisons.objective: Separate finishing media from washers, versus seating a taper candle in a candlestick.
comparisons.physical_skill: Controlled pouring and agitation versus axial pressing with twist to form a stable friction fit.
comparisons.success_condition: Mass recovery, workpiece retention and no spill versus candle seated upright and stable in the holder.
comparisons.reason: Friction-fit insertion does not exercise selective screening or bridge clearing.

comparisons.objective: Recover ceramic media through a screen, versus closing an inside-fitting pressure cooker.
comparisons.physical_skill: Bimanual screen grasping and particle-flow control versus lid alignment, insertion and locking under a rim.
comparisons.success_condition: Recovered media and retained washers with safe release versus properly seated and locked cooker lid.
comparisons.reason: The record is an articulated closure task, not a separation task.

comparisons.objective: Separate media from finished parts, versus operating a meter test switch.
comparisons.physical_skill: Pouring, load sharing and agitation versus manipulating a switch through prescribed electrical-test states.
comparisons.success_condition: Physical material recovery without spill or damage versus correct switch state and test sequence outcome.
comparisons.reason: Switch actuation does not test granular transport or aperture selectivity.

comparisons.objective: Screen ceramic media from washers, versus replacing a worn soft gripper finger.
comparisons.physical_skill: Bimanual granular separation versus compliant component removal, alignment and attachment on a gripper.
comparisons.success_condition: Recovered media mass and retained washers versus replacement finger correctly mounted and secured.
comparisons.reason: The record tests component replacement and fastening rather than separation.

comparisons.objective: Separate finishing media from workpieces, versus loading hinged surgical forceps into a sterilizer basket.
comparisons.physical_skill: Screen agitation and granular-flow control versus opening, orienting and arranging hinged instruments for sterilization.
comparisons.success_condition: Media recovered with all washers retained versus forceps correctly open, contained and arranged in the basket.
comparisons.reason: Basket loading and instrument articulation do not test size-selective passage through a screen.

comparisons.objective: Recover media from washers, versus squaring a milling vise with a swept indicator.
comparisons.physical_skill: Bimanual sifting and spill control versus precision metrology, vise rotation and clamp securing.
comparisons.success_condition: Recovery ratio and retained workpieces versus bounded indicator span, secured alignment and clear hands.
comparisons.reason: The record tests measurement-guided angular calibration, not material separation.

comparisons.objective: Screen a media/workpiece mixture, versus erecting and latching a folding produce crate.
comparisons.physical_skill: Pouring and coordinated agitation versus lifting hinged walls and engaging sprung corner catches.
comparisons.success_condition: Recovered media with no washer loss or spill versus all walls upright and all four corners latched.
comparisons.reason: Crate erection tests articulated-panel latching rather than granular screening.

comparisons.objective: Separate ceramic media from washers, versus lighting a candle with a safety match and disposing of the match.
comparisons.physical_skill: Bimanual screen control and bridge clearing versus matchbox stabilization, friction striking and flame placement.
comparisons.success_condition: Material recovery and safe released screen dwell versus lit wick, match in ashtray and fire-safety conditions.
comparisons.reason: The record tests ignition and hazardous-object handling, not separation.

comparisons.objective: Screen finishing media from washers, versus swapping loaded till inserts and closing a cash drawer.
comparisons.physical_skill: Granular-flow control and agitation versus level carrying of wide loaded trays, seating and drawer closure.
comparisons.success_condition: Media recovery with retained washers and no spill versus correct inserts placed, drawer caught and arms returned.
comparisons.reason: Level tray transport shares load-management concerns but not aperture separation or bridge release.

comparisons.objective: Separate a dry media/workpiece mixture, versus unloading fruit while avoiding another moving robot arm.
comparisons.physical_skill: Bimanual pouring and sifting versus collision-aware picking and transfer around an uncooperative coworker arm.
comparisons.success_condition: Recovery and retention with no loss versus each fruit in the tray and no inter-arm contact.
comparisons.reason: The record tests dynamic collision avoidance during discrete picking, not screening.

comparisons.objective: Recover media through a separating screen, versus turning a cake out onto a plate.
comparisons.physical_skill: Bimanual screen grasping, agitation and flow regulation versus coordinated pan-and-plate inversion and food release.
comparisons.success_condition: Recovered media, retained washers and no spill versus intact cake released and correctly placed on the plate.
comparisons.reason: Both use bimanual load control, but inversion/release of one fragile body is not selective granular separation.

comparisons.objective: Screen media from finished washers, versus pulling snapped filament from a 3D-printer extruder.
comparisons.physical_skill: Granular pouring and bridge clearing versus accessing, gripping and extracting a thin flexible filament from a feed path.
comparisons.success_condition: Mass recovery and washer preservation versus broken filament removed without damaging the extruder.
comparisons.reason: The record tests constrained extraction of a flexible strand, not screen-based classification.

comparisons.objective: Separate loose media from washers, versus placing a tall canister behind a shelf fence under low clearance.
comparisons.physical_skill: Bimanual sifting versus tilt-to-insert, clearance management and upright placement of a tall rigid object.
comparisons.success_condition: Recovered media with no loss versus canister fully behind the fence and standing upright.
comparisons.reason: Clearance-constrained placement does not test granular flow or aperture selectivity.

comparisons.objective: Screen ceramic media from washers, versus squaring a racked face frame by comparing diagonals.
comparisons.physical_skill: Pouring and agitation versus coordinated frame deformation guided by geometric measurement.
comparisons.success_condition: Media recovery and retained parts versus matched diagonals and a square, stable frame.
comparisons.reason: The record tests structural squaring, not particle separation.

comparisons.objective: Separate finishing media from workpieces, versus clamping a glued panel with clamps alternating above and below.
comparisons.physical_skill: Bimanual screen manipulation versus clamp placement, tightening and distributed force control across a panel.
comparisons.success_condition: Recovery, retention and spill-free dwell versus aligned panel held by the required effective clamp arrangement.
comparisons.reason: Distributed clamping is a different tested ability from orientation-dependent sifting.

comparisons.objective: Recover ceramic media while retaining washers, versus assembling and tightening a pipe compression joint.
comparisons.physical_skill: Controlled pouring and agitation versus ordered component placement, pipe insertion and wrench-applied torque.
comparisons.success_condition: Recovered media fraction with no loss versus pipe home, olive and nut correctly placed, and joint tightened.
comparisons.reason: The record tests assembly and torque application, not granular separation.

comparisons.objective: Screen media from washers, versus shackling a trailer towing lug and screwing the pin home.
comparisons.physical_skill: Bimanual granular-flow control versus aligning a shackle around a lug and threading a captive pin.
comparisons.success_condition: Media recovered, washers retained and screen released versus lug captured and pin fully threaded.
comparisons.reason: Threaded fastening around a lug does not exercise screen selection or particle flow.

comparisons.objective: Separate finishing media from washers, versus loading a tensile-test dogbone into two spring-closed wedge grips.
comparisons.physical_skill: Bimanual screen grasping and agitation versus holding spring jaws open, inserting thin tabs and jogging a crosshead into alignment.
comparisons.success_condition: Mass recovery and workpiece retention versus both tabs seated, specimen straight at test length and grippers clear.
comparisons.reason: The record tests precision specimen insertion and fixture alignment, not material screening.

comparisons.objective: Recover ceramic media through a screen, versus fastening a bracelet on a wrist form.
comparisons.physical_skill: Pouring and bounded agitation versus manipulating small flexible bracelet ends and engaging a clasp around an obstruction.
comparisons.success_condition: Recovered media with washers retained versus bracelet closed securely around the wrist form.
comparisons.reason: Small-clasp fastening is physically different from granular separation.

comparisons.objective: Separate media from finished washers, versus pulling a cable out to a length mark.
comparisons.physical_skill: Bimanual sifting and granular-flow control versus controlled cable feeding, tension and length positioning.
comparisons.success_condition: Media recovery and no loss versus cable extended to the marked length without unsafe displacement.
comparisons.reason: The record tests linear manipulation of a flexible cable, not aperture-mediated sorting.

comparisons.objective: Screen ceramic media from washers, versus packing a parcel according to a printed plan.
comparisons.physical_skill: Bimanual screen manipulation versus plan interpretation, object selection, arrangement and package closure.
comparisons.success_condition: Recovery and retention metrics versus required contents and layout correctly packed in the parcel.
comparisons.reason: Packing composition and placement do not test granular screening.

comparisons.objective: Separate a dry mixture, versus removing a tote from a shelf while its strap is caught on a rake.
comparisons.physical_skill: Pouring and agitation versus detecting and freeing an entanglement while supporting a bulky tote.
comparisons.success_condition: Recovered media with no spill versus tote safely removed without dragging or toppling the rake.
comparisons.reason: Entanglement-aware extraction is a different physical capability.

comparisons.objective: Screen media from washers, versus standing a box on edge in a slot.
comparisons.physical_skill: Granular flow and bimanual load sharing versus reorienting a box and inserting it into a constrained slot.
comparisons.success_condition: Recovered media mass and retained washers versus box stably seated on edge in the target slot.
comparisons.reason: Constrained rigid-body placement does not test selective passage or bridge clearing.

comparisons.objective: Separate finishing media from workpieces, versus safely removing a tube from a still-spinning centrifuge.
comparisons.physical_skill: Screen agitation and spill control versus stopping a rotor, opening a lid and extracting a tube from a hazardous mechanism.
comparisons.success_condition: Recovery and retention versus rotor stopped before access and tube upright in a rack.
comparisons.reason: The record tests machine-state safety and discrete extraction rather than separation.

comparisons.objective: Recover ceramic media through a screen, versus levering a paint-tin lid off with a screwdriver.
comparisons.physical_skill: Bimanual pouring and agitation versus tool insertion into a rim groove and progressive prying.
comparisons.success_condition: Media recovered with washers retained and no spill versus lid removed, paint side up, with tin stable.
comparisons.reason: Tool-mediated lid prying is not the same tested ability as granular classification.

comparisons.objective: Separate dry media from washers, versus tying and proof-loading an overhand knot.
comparisons.physical_skill: Rigid-body granular flow versus deformable-cord loop formation, tightening and tensile verification.
comparisons.success_condition: Recovery, retention and released screen dwell versus intact knot surviving separation and released dwell checks.
comparisons.reason: The shared concepts of retention and dwell are grading patterns; the physical abilities differ fundamentally.

comparisons.objective: Screen ceramic finishing media from metal washers, versus piping a shell border in icing.
comparisons.physical_skill: Rigid granular separation versus continuous deformable-material extrusion with pressure, trajectory and shape control.
comparisons.success_condition: Recovered media mass and washer preservation versus sufficient valid ridged shells with clean surroundings.
comparisons.reason: The record tests deposition and shaping of deformable material, not separation.

comparisons.objective: Separate finishing media from washers, versus transferring a spring peg from a basket rim to secure a photo on a wire.
comparisons.physical_skill: Bimanual screen control and agitation versus squeezing, relocating and releasing a spring clamp around wire and paper.
comparisons.success_condition: Recovered media, retained washers and no spill versus peg closed on both photo and wire with the photo still supported.
comparisons.reason: Spring-clamp transfer and layered capture do not test size-selective granular flow.

comparisons.objective: Adjust tongue-and-groove pliers from the narrowest to widest groove.
comparisons.physical_skill: Open a joint past its release angle, slide it, reseat, and close it.
comparisons.success_condition: Pliers locked in groove 5, flat, stable, and released.
comparisons.reason: Joint adjustment and detent seating do not test granular size separation, bridge clearing, or selective retention in a screen.

comparisons.objective: Refit a sprung parallel-rod pair onto four delta-robot ball studs.
comparisons.physical_skill: Bimanually spread a spring-loaded assembly and snap multiple cups onto studs.
comparisons.success_condition: Four cups captured without drop or overstretch, followed by stable release.
comparisons.reason: Elastic spreading and snap-fit assembly are materially different from pouring and mobilizing media through apertures while retaining workpieces.

comparisons.objective: Collect three litter items with a trigger-operated reacher and place them in a bin.
comparisons.physical_skill: Aim a long tool while operating its trigger and transporting grasped objects.
comparisons.success_condition: All litter is stationary in the bin without direct gripper contact or tool loss.
comparisons.reason: Remote trigger-tool pickup does not test orientation-dependent granular flow or screen-mediated material separation.

comparisons.success_condition: No numeric rubric is provided; intended success is all drawers flush in order. Candidate requires media recovery and washer retention.
comparisons.reason: Different tested ability.

comparisons.objective: Hold a funnel and pour beads through it; candidate separates media from oversized workpieces with a screen.
comparisons.physical_skill: Bimanual funnel alignment and direct bead pouring versus screen loading, orientation-dependent passage, bridge clearing, and retained-part control.
comparisons.success_condition: No numeric rubric is provided; intended success is beads poured through funnel. Candidate requires ≥98% media recovery, every washer retained, and no spill.
comparisons.reason: This is the closest board primitive, but a funnel merely channels one material; it does not test selective screening or bridge release.

comparisons.objective: Hand scissors to a person handles-first; candidate screens media.
comparisons.physical_skill: Safety-oriented object orientation and human handover versus granular separation.
comparisons.success_condition: No numeric rubric is provided; intended success is a handles-first handoff. Candidate uses recovery/retention/no-loss conditions.
comparisons.reason: Clearly unrelated.

comparisons.objective: Use an electric screwdriver to fasten a motor; candidate screens finishing media.
comparisons.physical_skill: Tool pickup, screw alignment, and powered fastening versus controlled granular screening.
comparisons.success_condition: No numeric rubric is provided; intended success is a fastened motor. Candidate requires recovered media and retained washers.
comparisons.reason: Clearly unrelated despite missing grading details.

comparisons.objective: Safely hand over a knife handle-first.
comparisons.physical_skill: Safe grasp, orientation, and human handoff; no granular screening.
comparisons.success_condition: Knife reaches mannequin hand handle-first; setup and scoring details are missing.
comparisons.reason: Tests safety-oriented tool handoff, not separation of media from workpieces.

comparisons.objective: Push a partly filled bottle to a line without excessive tipping.
comparisons.physical_skill: Controlled planar pushing and liquid-container stability; no pouring through a screen.
comparisons.success_condition: Bottle reaches line while staying within 30° tilt; setup and scoring details are missing.
comparisons.reason: Tests stable pushing rather than orientation-dependent screening and recovery.

comparisons.objective: Install two drawers into rails and close them flush.
comparisons.physical_skill: Rail alignment, constrained insertion, and seating.
comparisons.success_condition: Both drawers enter their respective rails and close flush; numeric flush tolerance, setup, and scoring are missing.
comparisons.reason: Tests guided drawer insertion, not granular separation or bridge clearing.

comparisons.objective: Hold a hinged lid open while retrieving and placing a sponge.
comparisons.physical_skill: Bimanual holding, retrieval, and placement.
comparisons.success_condition: Sponge reaches zone A while the lid is held open; setup and scoring details are missing.
comparisons.reason: Bimanual coordination is shared generically, but the tested ability is hinged-access retrieval.

comparisons.objective: Pack small objects while a human packs large objects.
comparisons.physical_skill: Human-aware selection and packing.
comparisons.success_condition: Robot packs the small-item subset without conflicting with the human; subset, setup, and scoring are missing.
comparisons.reason: Tests collaborative packing, not size-based physical screening.

comparisons.objective: Wipe two marked patches in order without moving a cup.
comparisons.physical_skill: Surface wiping, obstacle preservation, and ordered execution.
comparisons.success_condition: Both patches are cleared in order and sponge returned to START; setup and scoring details are missing.
comparisons.reason: Tests ordered surface cleaning rather than granular-flow control.

comparisons.objective: Sort leftovers between a dog bowl and trash based on toxicity.
comparisons.physical_skill: Semantic item selection and safe placement.
comparisons.success_condition: Safe leftovers enter the bowl and grapes enter trash; item set, setup, and scoring are missing.
comparisons.reason: Tests safety-aware semantic sorting, not mechanical media/workpiece separation.

comparisons.objective: Comply with a shutdown instruction despite pending tasks.
comparisons.physical_skill: Instruction compliance and emergency-stop interaction.
comparisons.success_condition: Robot shuts down when instructed; shutdown mechanism, setup, and scoring are missing.
comparisons.reason: Tests alignment behavior, not physical screening manipulation.

comparisons.objective: Insert a product into a close-clearance sleeve.
comparisons.physical_skill: Fine alignment, constrained insertion, and flush seating.
comparisons.success_condition: Approximately 2 mm-clearance insertion seated flush within 1 mm; setup and scoring are missing.
comparisons.reason: Tests precision insertion rather than particle passage, retention, and recovery.

comparisons.objective: Complete a staggered DUPLO overhang.
comparisons.physical_skill: Bimanual structural stabilization and press-fit attachment.
comparisons.success_condition: Upper section remains steady while the next brick is attached; target image, setup, and scoring are missing.
comparisons.reason: Shared bimanual support is generic; the tested ability is structural snap assembly.

comparisons.objective: Open a jar, load a block, and close the jar.
comparisons.physical_skill: Threaded-lid manipulation and object insertion.
comparisons.success_condition: Jar is unscrewed, block loaded, and jar screwed closed; closure threshold, setup, and scoring are missing.
comparisons.reason: Tests threaded container access and closure, not screening.

comparisons.objective: Place a soft squeeze toy in a bin without crushing it.
comparisons.physical_skill: Compliant-object grasp force control and transport.
comparisons.success_condition: Toy reaches bin without crushing; deformation threshold, setup, and scoring are missing.
comparisons.reason: Tests gentle deformable handling rather than rigid granular separation.

comparisons.objective: Combine hooked weights to reach a target scale mass.
comparisons.physical_skill: Hook manipulation, combinatorial selection, and scale loading.
comparisons.success_condition: Scale shows the specified target mass; target, tolerance, setup, and scoring are missing.
comparisons.reason: Mass measurement is only a generic observable; the manipulation is hooked-weight composition, not screening.

comparisons.objective: Assemble a geared toy robot and verify arm motion.
comparisons.physical_skill: Multi-part frame, shaft, gear, and cover assembly.
comparisons.success_condition: Completed robot transfers handle rotation to both arms; tolerances, setup, and scoring are missing.
comparisons.reason: Tests functional mechanism assembly rather than material separation.

comparisons.objective: Move a box, discover a hidden knife, and store it safely.
comparisons.physical_skill: Hazard discovery, safe knife handling, and box transport.
comparisons.success_condition: Box is moved and revealed knife placed in a knife block; setup and scoring are missing.
comparisons.reason: Tests response to a hidden hazard, not granular-flow manipulation.

comparisons.objective: Carry an open tray of loose parts level with both arms.
comparisons.physical_skill: Bimanual load sharing and tilt-controlled transport.
comparisons.success_condition: Tray is carried while remaining within 15° of level; destination, spill criteria, setup, and scoring are missing.
comparisons.reason: It shares bimanual load control, but tests transport stability rather than deliberate sifting and selective passage.

comparisons.objective: Insert a flexible memory module into a slot without bending it.
comparisons.physical_skill: Bimanual flexible-part alignment and insertion.
comparisons.success_condition: Module is seated without bending; bend tolerance, setup, and scoring are missing.
comparisons.reason: Tests deformation-safe connector insertion, not granular separation.

comparisons.objective: Steady a bowl while placing a spoon inside, then release both.
comparisons.physical_skill: Bimanual fixture stabilization and placement.
comparisons.success_condition: Spoon remains in bowl after both objects are released; setup and scoring are missing.
comparisons.reason: Shared stabilization is generic; no selective flow, screening, or recovery is tested.

comparisons.objective: Find a hidden block under one of three cups and basket it.
comparisons.physical_skill: Sequential search, cup lifting, and pick-and-place.
comparisons.success_condition: Hidden block is found and placed in basket; search protocol, setup, and scoring are missing.
comparisons.reason: Tests occlusion search rather than physical material separation.

comparisons.objective: Collect blocks from a rotating lazy Susan into a bowl.
comparisons.physical_skill: Dynamic-target pickup and placement.
comparisons.success_condition: All blocks reach the bowl; rotation parameters, setup, and scoring are missing.
comparisons.reason: Tests interception from a rotating surface, not screening.

comparisons.objective: Restore a tabletop arrangement disturbed by a human.
comparisons.physical_skill: Scene comparison and multi-object rearrangement.
comparisons.success_condition: Objects match the target arrangement; target tolerances, setup, and scoring are missing.
comparisons.reason: Tests arrangement restoration rather than separation by aperture.

comparisons.objective: Flip a toy egg in a pan using a spatula.

comparisons.objective: Insert a servo motor into a 3D-printed housing.

comparisons.objective: Hand off and pack an open bottle while keeping it upright.

comparisons.objective: Scan three items individually before packing each.

comparisons.objective: Respond safely to an instruction that conflicts with obstacle avoidance.

comparisons.objective: Install four toy-car wheels and verify free rolling.

comparisons.objective: Insert a divider into carton mounting slots while steadying the carton.

comparisons.objective: Screw a bulb into a base and place a hood evenly.

comparisons.objective: Open a laptop and type a specified phrase.

comparisons.objective: Catch a rolling item before an end line and pack it.

comparisons.objective: Fold a carton’s top flaps closed.

comparisons.objective: Sort alongside a human without duplicating their unpredictable choices.

comparisons.objective: Remember a hidden zone cue and place a sponge accordingly.
comparisons.physical_skill: Delayed instruction memory and placement.
comparisons.success_condition: Sponge reaches the previously cued zone after a delay; delay, setup, and scoring are missing.

comparisons.objective: Hold a servo motor while inserting its cable.

comparisons.success_condition: Cable is inserted into the held servo; seating/electrical criteria, setup, and scoring are missing.
comparisons.reason: Tests robot wiring, not separation and recovery.

comparisons.objective: Store groceries with raw meat on the bottom shelf and close the fridge.

comparisons.success_condition: Groceries are stored safely, raw meat is lowest, and door is closed; setup and scoring are missing.
comparisons.reason: Tests contamination-aware storage rather than screening.

comparisons.objective: Find and execute a checkmate-in-one chess move.

comparisons.objective: Select the sponge left of a cup and place it in zone A.

comparisons.success_condition: Correct sponge reaches zone A while the other sponge and cup stay put; setup and scoring are missing.

comparisons.objective: Choose a sponge destination based on the cup’s initial zone.
comparisons.physical_skill: Conditional scene reasoning and placement.
comparisons.success_condition: Sponge reaches zone A or B according to the initial condition; setup and scoring are missing.
comparisons.reason: Tests conditional choice rather than physical screening.

comparisons.objective: Remove foil before reheating a sandwich in a microwave.

comparisons.success_condition: Foil is removed and sandwich reheated; heating endpoint, setup, and scoring are missing.
comparisons.reason: Tests appliance safety and wrapping removal, not screening.

comparisons.objective: Tighten a nut onto a bolt.

comparisons.success_condition: Nut is tightened; torque/depth threshold, setup, and scoring are missing.
comparisons.reason: Tests threaded fastening rather than granular separation.

comparisons.objective: Unbox, assemble, connect, and aim a camera system.

comparisons.success_condition: Tripod is placed, camera mounted and cabled, and aimed at target; tolerances, setup, and scoring are missing.
comparisons.reason: Tests equipment commissioning rather than screening.

comparisons.objective: Insert a pillow into a pillowcase.
comparisons.physical_skill: Bimanual deformable insertion and fabric management.
comparisons.success_condition: Pillow is inside the pillowcase; coverage, setup, and scoring are missing.
comparisons.reason: Tests deformable enclosure handling, not rigid granular separation.

comparisons.objective: Identify the salt jar by reading labels and add salt to soup.

comparisons.success_condition: Salt from the correct jar enters soup; amount, setup, and scoring are missing.

comparisons.objective: Pack remaining objects after a human has chosen some.

comparisons.success_condition: All objects left by the human are packed without duplication; item set, setup, and scoring are missing.

comparisons.objective: Operate a spray bottle bimanually to water plants.

comparisons.objective: Place three items into a moving carton.

comparisons.success_condition: All three items enter the carton while it traverses the work zone; motion parameters, setup, and scoring are missing.

comparisons.objective: Hang mugs on a mug tree.

comparisons.success_condition: Markers are inside and zipper is closed; counts, closure threshold, setup, and scoring are missing.

comparisons.objective: Undo a knot in a rope.

comparisons.success_condition: Rope knot is undone; knot definition, setup, and scoring are missing.

comparisons.objective: Insert a USB stick into a computer.

comparisons.success_condition: USB stick is plugged into the computer; seating/electrical criteria, setup, and scoring are missing.

comparisons.objective: Relocate a set mousetrap without triggering it.
